stem: A test of a new search bar reaches its planned sample size and ends with p = 0.20. Which conclusion fits?

options.text: The search bar has no effect on conversion, so the idea can be ruled out
There is no clear evidence of an effect, but a real one is still possible
There is a 20% chance that the search bar has an effect on conversion
The search bar works, but its effect is 20% smaller than the plan assumed
